# Q-SHIFT Stage 5 — Pre-execution Protocol and Implementation Freeze v2

**Status:** implementation/preflight package only. This document does not authorize Stage 5 sampling. No Stage 5 calibration or evaluation samples are generated by this package unless the runner is explicitly invoked with both guarded flags after separate project authorization.

## Scientific question and arms

For the selected Stage 4C detector-profile probability estimator, does profile-calibrated PyMatching reduce logical error rate relative to fixed nominal PyMatching across the prespecified synthetic burst probabilities? The frozen selected method is the **Stage 4C refit of the Stage 4B detector-profile estimator**. The CNN was dropped in Stage 4C and is not reintroduced. The true-probability PyMatching arm is a privileged reference, never a deployable policy.

The three arms are: (1) fixed nominal PyMatching, constructed with burst p=0 and the frozen gate/measurement model; (2) detector-only profile estimate followed by a rebuilt PyMatching DEM; and (3) privileged true-p reference. All arms use identical evaluation detector rows and are scored against one aligned observable vector.

## Frozen circuit and allocation

Rotated surface-code Z memory, d=3, five rounds, 40 detectors, one logical observable; gate p=.003, measurement p=.003, balanced Pauli regime with bias ratio 10. Synthetic spatial burst event: per-round `CORRELATED_ERROR(p) X8 X10`, with independent event occurrence by round. It is a simulator proxy, not measured hardware noise. The DEM uses `decompose_errors=True, approximate_disjoint_errors=True`; PyMatching enables correlations.

For p in `{0,.004,.008,.012,.016}`, use 100 roots/condition, 2,000 detector-only calibration shots/root and 2,500 paired evaluation shots/root. Totals: 1,000,000 calibration + 1,250,000 evaluation = 2,250,000 unique shots, below the frozen 2,500,000 cap. Existing Stage 5 seed inventory is copied byte-for-byte. It allocates 1,000 shot streams and bootstrap/sign-flip seeds `4240001001`/`4240001002`; full candidate seed screening covered 4,171 recoverable historical development seed values with no collision, but undocumented historical RNG use remains unknowable. Stage 5 v2 validates all 1,002 values and stream keys before sampling.

## Estimator and leakage boundary

The Stage 4C frozen profile file is the estimator parameter source and remains hash-identical to the candidate. The estimator uses 40 detector marginals plus five prespecified detector cofire features, interpolated across profile knots `{0,.01,.02}` and a 1e-5 grid. It receives only the 2,000 calibration detector rows. It does not receive true p, burst flags, evaluation detectors, or observables. Stage 5 does not refit it.

The runner generates calibration detectors into a durable checkpoint, then generates the paired evaluation detectors and observable, and then predicts all arms before any outcome scoring. A restart reuses durable partial arrays; if a simulator stream was marked in-flight but its array is not durably saved, the runner refuses to replay that stream. Test labels are present only for post-prediction scoring and are never passed to the estimator or decoder constructors. No sealed independent-test path is used or enumerated.

## Endpoints and statistics

Primary endpoint: equal-weight mean across p=.004,.008,.012,.016 of the 100 root-level paired LER differences (profile adaptive minus fixed nominal). Paired raw error counts and candidate-only/fixed-only shot discordances are reported by condition and root. Root is the inferential cluster; no shot-level bootstrap is used.

Primary CI: 95% stratified root-cluster percentile bootstrap, 20,000 resamples. One PCG64 generator, seed `4240001001`: draw condition index matrices in ascending p order, each shape `(20,000,100)`; calculate the equal-weight mean of condition means; then draw p=0 root index matrices and use the 95th percentile as the one-sided no-harm upper bound.

Primary p-value: two-sided root-cluster sign-flip, 100,000 Monte Carlo assignments, PCG64 seed `4240001002`. For each assignment, flip each root difference independently, stratified by condition; compute equal-weight mean across four strata. Ties count as extreme; plus-one correction. Consume the stream for the primary first, then the four p-specific tests ascending. This is an approximate one-sample sign-symmetry test, **not** a treatment randomization test. Interpretation depends on root-level independent sampling and sign-symmetry under the tested null. The independent audit reports this condition explicitly.

The four condition-level tests form one Holm family. The frozen success gate remains: primary mean ≤−.0002; primary root bootstrap upper endpoint <0; primary sign-flip p<.05; all four nonzero condition point means favor adaptive with no condition harm >+.0002; p=0 one-sided bootstrap upper endpoint ≤+.0002. Condition-specific superiority is not claimed unless supported by Holm-adjusted results; the point-mean gate alone is not inferential evidence.

## Prospective statistical clarification

The historical candidate said to resample roots within conditions but did not specify exact generator draw order. This v2 file prospectively fixes the draw order and bootstrap array dimensions above so runner and independent audit can reproduce the same intervals bit-for-bit. It preserves the candidate's estimand, root resampling, confidence level, seed, p-value method, multiplicity family, and decision thresholds. The candidate files remain unchanged as historical records.

The independent power review found the candidate SE calculation reproducible, but the sign-flip test's exactness is conditional on sign symmetry. The candidate's approximately 87.5% number applies to rejecting the zero null at an effect of −.0002; the conjunction gate additionally requires a point estimate at or below −.0002, giving only 50% probability for that condition exactly at its boundary before the all-strata rule. The only per-condition SD inputs are from seven roots/cell; power is therefore provisional, not guaranteed.

## Saved-array audit

Each completed root file stores calibration detectors, evaluation detectors, aligned observable labels, all three prediction vectors, the estimator output, p/root, and both sampling seeds. Root files are written atomically with phase-tagged resumable checkpoints. A separate audit script does not import the runner or its statistics; it independently reconstructs the detector-profile estimate, rebuilds Stim DEM/PyMatching models, re-decodes stored detector arrays, recomputes paired outcomes and statistics, and verifies root-file SHA-256 against the runner manifest. The audit remains read-only.

## Readiness/resource limits

CPU only; process RSS below 2 GiB; 1,800 seconds cumulative wall time; 2,500,000 unique-shot hard cap. Runner checks stored root progress, sample-array dimensions, seed mapping, hashes, and resource limits. Preflight uses circuit/DEM construction and synthetic deterministic arrays only; it does not call Stim's sampler. Historical Stage 4B and Stage 4C throughputs suggest the allocation may fit the time cap, but the no-shot benchmark cannot establish full sampling throughput. See the readiness report.

Sampling command is deliberately gated and must not be run as part of this readiness task:

```powershell
python -m outputs.stage5_preexecution_v1.stage5_runner --run --authorize-stage5-sampling
```

Passing unit tests, hashes, or preflight does **not** provide the separate authorization required to invoke this command.
